slides.headline: Stop wasting time on repetitive design tasks
slides.body: Cosy lets you generate branded visuals from JSON input. No more manual Photoshop edits for every post.

slides.headline: Templates that adapt to your brand
slides.body: Define your brand colors, fonts, and logo once. Every template uses them automatically.

slides.headline: From JSON to PNG in milliseconds
slides.body: Feed data, get pixels. Perfect for batch generation and automated content pipelines.

slides.headline: Built for developers, loved by marketers
slides.body: CLI-first, API-ready. Integrate into your existing workflow without learning new tools.

slides.headline: Open source. Self-hosted. Yours.
slides.body: No subscription, no vendor lock-in. Run it on your infrastructure.
